kerolox.name: Kerosene + LOX
kerolox.special: Cheap and compact. The weakest of the three.

methalox.name: Methane + LOX
methalox.special: Can be made on Mars from ice and CO₂ (Sabatier), so it can refuel the return.
methalox.real: Raptor 327/350 s (380 s vacuum bell), BE-4 ~340 s

hydrolox.name: Hydrogen + LOX
hydrolox.special: The most efficient, but it boils off slowly during the cruise and needs huge tanks.

sl.name: Sea-level nozzle
sl.note: Short bell tuned for 1 atm. Strong off the pad, wasteful in vacuum.

vac.name: Vacuum nozzle
vac.note: Long bell tuned for vacuum. Efficient in space, weak and unstable at sea level.

references.name: Merlin 1D
references.facts: 845 kN sea level / 914 kN vacuum · Isp 282 / 311 s · 470 kg · gas generator · pintle injector · TEA-TEB ignition · 97 bar · first flight 2013

references.name: Raptor 2
references.facts: 2,256 kN sea level / 2,530 kN vacuum · Isp 327 / 350 s · 1,630 kg · full-flow staged combustion · ~300 bar · throttles 40–100 %

references.name: BE-4
references.maker: Blue Origin, Vulcan and New Glenn
references.facts: 2,460 kN sea level · Isp ~340 s · 5,400 kg · oxygen-rich staged combustion · 134 bar · throttles 40–100 % · first flight 2024

references.name: RS-25 (Space Shuttle Main Engine)
references.facts: 1,860 kN sea level / 2,279 kN vacuum · Isp 366 / 452 s · 3,177 kg · fuel-rich staged combustion · 206 bar · expansion 69 · throttles 67–109 % · first flight 1981

references.name: Vulcain 2
references.facts: 940 kN sea level / 1,350 kN vacuum · Isp 318 / 434 s · 1,800 kg · gas generator · 116 bar · expansion 61 · first flight 2002

references.name: RD-180
references.facts: 3,830 kN sea level / 4,150 kN vacuum · Isp 313 / 339 s · 5,480 kg · oxygen-rich staged combustion, two chambers · 257 bar · throttles 50–100 % · first flight 2000

references.name: RD-0124
references.facts: 294 kN vacuum · Isp 359 s · 480 kg · staged combustion, four chambers · 162 bar · burn 300 s

references.name: RL10B-2
references.maker: Aerojet Rocketdyne, Delta IV and Centaur
references.facts: 110 kN vacuum · Isp 462 s · ~300 kg · expander cycle · expansion ratio 250 with an extendable carbon-carbon skirt · restartable · family first flew 1961

references.name: J-2X
references.facts: 1,310 kN vacuum · Isp 448 s · 2,430 kg · gas generator · expansion 80 · three restarts · never flew

references.name: Rutherford
references.facts: 25 kN sea level / 26 kN vacuum · Isp 311 / 343 s · 35 kg · battery-driven electric pumps · 3D-printed chamber · first flight 2017

references.name: AJ10-118K (Delta II second stage)
references.facts: 43 kN vacuum · Isp 320 s · 98 kg · pressure-fed, hypergolic (N₂O₄ / Aerozine-50, nearest here: kerolox) · expansion 65 · unlimited restarts · flew 1982–2018
